question: How do credible complete systems perform against equivalent task outcomes, evidence requirements, authority, and resource bounds?
system_decomposition: unconstrained; register each system before evaluation and do not force a shared internal workflow
equivalence_requirements: same maximum wall time and fully loaded cost envelope
same evidence retention and failure accounting
decision_rule: Report uncertainty and task-family differences. Do not infer superiority from one case or from an unmatched authority or cost envelope.
